title.zh: 卷238 列傳二十五 蒋赫德 额色赫 车克 觉罗巴哈纳 宋权 傅以渐 吕宫 成克巩 金之俊 王永吉 党崇雅
title.en: Volume 238 Biographies 25: Jiang Hede, E Se He, Che Ke, Jue Luo Ba Ha Na, Song Quan, Fu Yijian, Lv Gong, Cheng Kegong, Jin Zhijun, Wang Yongji, Dang Chongya
title.raw: 卷238 列傳二十五 蒋赫德 额色赫 车克 觉罗巴哈纳 宋权 傅以渐 吕宫 成克巩 金之俊 王永吉 党崇雅

sentences.zh: 蔣赫德，初名元恆，遵化人。

translations.literal: Jiang Hede, originally named Yuan Heng, was a native of Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Hede, whose original name was Yuan Heng, came from Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，太宗伐明，克遵化，選儒生俊秀者入文館，元恆與焉，賜名赫德。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, the Taizong attacked Ming, captured Zunhua, selected outstanding Confucian scholars to enter the Literary Institute; Yuan Heng was among them and was granted the name Hede.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiancong the Taizong campaigned against the Ming and took Zunhua. Outstanding scholars were chosen for the Literary Institute; Yuan Heng was one of them and received the granted name Hede.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，授秘書院副理事官，予四戶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, he was appointed Deputy Director of the Secretariat College and granted four households.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde he was made Deputy Director of the Secretariat College and allotted four households.

sentences.zh: 漢軍旗制定，隸鑲白旗。

translations.literal: When the Han Military Banner system was established, he was placed under the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: After the Han Military Banners were formally organized, he was assigned to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，擢國史館學士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, he was promoted to Academician of the National History Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shunzhi he was promoted to National History Academician.

sentences.zh: 九年，朝鮮國王李淏奏國內外奸徒謀不軌，巳伏其辜，命與侍郎伊勒都齎敕往慰問。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the King of Korea, Yi Ho, memorialized that traitors inside and outside the state had plotted sedition and had already been punished; he was ordered to proceed with Vice Minister Yiledu, carrying an edict, to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the King of Korea, Yi Ho, reported that domestic and foreign plotters had already been punished for their sedition. Jiang was ordered to accompany Vice Minister Yiledu, bearing an imperial edict, on a mission of reassurance to Korea.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢國史院大學士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was promoted to Grand Academician of the National History College.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Grand Academician of the National History College.

sentences.zh: 十二年，詔諸大臣陳時務，疏言：「察吏乃可安民，除害乃可興利。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, an edict called on all ministers to address current affairs; he submitted a memorial saying: 'Inspecting officials is how one can secure the people; removing harm is how one can promote benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the throne ordered ministers to set forth current affairs. Jiang submitted a memorial: 'Only by scrutinizing officials can the people be settled; only by removing harm can profit be fostered.

sentences.zh: 今百姓大害，莫甚於貪官蠹吏。

translations.literal: Today the greatest harm to the common people is nothing worse than corrupt officials and predatory clerks.
translations.idiomatic: At present no affliction of the common people is graver than corrupt officials and predatory clerks.

sentences.zh: 懲治之法，惟恃督撫糾劾，以其確知屬吏之賢不肖也。

translations.literal: The method of punishment relies solely on governors-general and governors memorializing impeachments, because they know precisely whether their subordinate officials are capable or not.
translations.idiomatic: Punishment depends entirely on governors-general and governors filing impeachments, for they alone know their subordinates' merit and demerit with certainty.

sentences.zh: 近每見各督撫彈章，指事列款，贓跡累累；

translations.literal: Recently one constantly sees impeachment memorials from each governor-general and governor, itemizing charges with evidence of embezzlement piled up;
translations.idiomatic: Lately one constantly sees impeachment memorials from governors-general and governors, listing charges item by item with evidence of graft piled high;

sentences.zh: 及奉旨勘讞，計贓科罪，不及十之二三。

translations.literal: yet when an imperial order comes to investigate and judge, counting embezzlement and imposing penalties, not even two or three in ten are reached.
translations.idiomatic: yet when cases are investigated and sentenced under imperial order, convictions based on counted embezzlement reach fewer than two or three in ten.

sentences.zh: 不曰'事屬子虛'，則曰'衙役作弊'。

translations.literal: They say either 'the matter is entirely fabricated' or 'the yamen runners committed fraud.'
translations.idiomatic: The finding is either that the charges were wholly fabricated or that yamen runners committed fraud.

sentences.zh: 即坐衙役者，又多引雜犯律例，聽其贖免，何所懲憚而不肆行其志乎？

translations.literal: Even when runners are convicted, they often invoke miscellaneous offenses under the statutes and are allowed to redeem punishment—what is there to fear, and why would they not act on their will as they please?
translations.idiomatic: Even when runners are convicted, they often invoke miscellaneous statutes and are allowed to buy their way out—what is there to deter them from acting as they please?

sentences.zh: 其始官胥朋比，虐取瓜分；

translations.literal: At first officials and clerks colluded as partners, cruelly extracting and dividing the spoils;
translations.idiomatic: At first officials and clerks colluded, cruelly extorting and dividing the spoils among themselves;

sentences.zh: 事敗，官嫁名於吏以覬燃灰，吏假貲於官以成展脫。

translations.literal: When the affair failed, officials shifted blame onto clerks hoping for escape like phoenix from ashes; clerks borrowed wealth from officials to achieve release and evasion.
translations.idiomatic: When exposed, officials shifted blame onto clerks in hope of rising from the ashes unscathed, while clerks borrowed funds from officials to secure their release.

sentences.zh: 究之官吏優游，兩獲無恙，糾劾雖行，竟成故事。

translations.literal: In the end officials and clerks remained at ease, both escaping unscathed; impeachment though pursued became mere precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the end officials and clerks went unscathed on both sides; impeachment, though carried out, became nothing more than routine.

sentences.zh: 請嚴飭各督撫，糾劾勘讞覆奏時，必全述原參疏語，某款不實，或開報虛構，或承問故縱，窮源質訊，是非不容並立；

translations.literal: I request that each governor-general and governor be strictly ordered that when reporting on impeachment, investigation, and judgment, they must fully quote the original impeachment memorial; if a charge is untrue, or a report was fabricated, or questioning was deliberately lax, trace to the source and interrogate—right and wrong cannot stand together;
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors-general and governors be strictly instructed: when reporting on impeachment investigations, they must quote the original memorial in full. If a charge proves false, or a report was fabricated, or questioning was deliberately lax, the matter must be traced to its source—truth and falsehood cannot both stand;

sentences.zh: 實係衙役詐騙，按律坐以應得之罪，不許折贖，則貪蠹清而民蘇矣。」

translations.literal: if it truly was yamen runners committing fraud, punish according to law with the due penalty and do not allow commutation by redemption—then corruption will be cleared and the people will revive.'
translations.idiomatic: if yamen runners truly committed fraud, punish them under the statute with the full penalty and forbid commutation—then graft will be cleared away and the people will breathe again.

sentences.zh: 得旨，下所司嚴飭行。

translations.literal: The memorial received imperial approval, and orders were sent down to the relevant offices for strict enforcement.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial received imperial approval, and orders were sent to the relevant offices for strict enforcement.

sentences.zh: 旋加太子太保。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改文華殿大學士，兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was transferred to Grand Academician of the Wenhua Hall and concurrently served as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made Grand Academician of the Wenhua Hall and concurrently Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十六年，加少保。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was additionally appointed Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he received the additional title of Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 命齎冊封朝鮮國王李H7，侍讀碩博輝副之。

translations.literal: He was ordered to carry the investiture patent to invest the King of Korea, Yi Ho; Reader Shuobohui served as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to carry the investiture patent to Korea to invest King Yi Ho, with Reader Shuobohui as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 蔣赫德屢充殿試讀卷官、教習庶吉士。

translations.literal: Jiang Hede repeatedly served as reader of palace examination papers and as instructor of Hanlin bachelors.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Hede repeatedly served as reader of palace examination papers and as instructor of Hanlin bachelors.

sentences.zh: 修輯明史、太宗實錄，充副總裁；

translations.literal: He compiled and edited the History of Ming and the Veritable Records of Taizong, serving as deputy chief compiler;
translations.idiomatic: He helped compile the History of Ming and the Veritable Records of Taizong as deputy chief compiler;

sentences.zh: 太祖、太宗聖訓充總裁。

translations.literal: for the Sacred Instructions of Taizu and Taizong he served as chief compiler.
translations.idiomatic: and served as chief compiler for the Sacred Instructions of Taizu and Taizong.

sentences.zh: 譯三國志成，賜鞍馬。

translations.literal: When the translation of Romance of the Three Kingdoms was completed, he was granted a saddle and horse.
translations.idiomatic: When his translation of Romance of the Three Kingdoms was completed, he was rewarded with a saddle and horse.

sentences.zh: 十七年，引疾乞休。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, citing illness he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he cited illness and asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，起為弘文院大學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, he was recalled and appointed Grand Academician of the Hongwen College.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi he was recalled and appointed Grand Academician of the Hongwen College.

sentences.zh: 二年，調國史院。

translations.literal: In the second year, he was transferred to the National History College.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to the National History College.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he died and was posthumously titled Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died and was given the posthumous title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 蔣赫德初為明諸生，嘗應鄉試，夜聞明遠樓鼓聲，曰：「此頹敗之氣，國安能久？」

translations.literal: Jiang Hede was originally a Ming licentiate; he once went to take the provincial examination, and at night heard the drum from Mingyuan Tower and said: 'This is the breath of decay—how can the state endure long?'
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Hede had begun as a Ming licentiate. Once, while sitting for the provincial examination, he heard at night the drum from Mingyuan Tower and said, 'That is the breath of a failing order—how can such a state endure?'

sentences.zh: 不終試而去。

translations.literal: He did not finish the examination and left.
translations.idiomatic: He left without finishing the examination.

sentences.zh: 遍遊九邊，曰：「王氣在遼、瀋，將有聖人出，吾蓄才以待可也。」

translations.literal: He traveled throughout the nine border regions and said: 'The royal aura is in Liaodong and Shenyang; a sage will arise—I have stored my talent and may wait for him.'
translations.idiomatic: He traveled the nine frontier regions and said, 'The royal aura lies in Liaodong and Shenyang; a sage will appear. I have kept my talents in reserve and may wait for him.'

sentences.zh: 旋為太宗賞拔，卒致通顯。

translations.literal: Soon he was favored and promoted by the Taizong, and in the end attained high eminence.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon singled out by the Taizong and in the end rose to high office.

sentences.zh: 額色赫，富察氏，滿洲鑲白旗人，世居訥殷。

translations.literal: Esehe, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner, his family having long resided in Nehe.
translations.idiomatic: Esehe, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner whose family had long lived in Nehe.

sentences.zh: 祖莽吉圖，當太祖時，從其兄孟古慎郭和來歸。

translations.literal: His grandfather Mangjitu, in the time of Taizu, followed his elder brother Menggushenguohe in coming to submit.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Mangjitu, in the time of Taizu, followed his elder brother Menggushenguohe in submitting to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 額色赫事太宗，從征伐，自巴牙喇壯達授兵部理事官。

translations.literal: Esehe served the Taizong, followed on campaigns, and from Bayara squad leader was appointed Director of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Esehe served the Taizong on campaign and rose from Bayara squad leader to Director of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，從梅勒額真巴奇蘭伐黑龍江部，使還奏捷。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tiancong, he followed Meile-i Jinggin Baqilan in attacking the Heilongjiang tribes; sent back, he reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tiancong he followed Meile-i Jinggin Baqilan against the Heilongjiang tribes and returned as envoy to report victory.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，擢秘書院學士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, he was promoted to Academician of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was promoted to Secretariat Academician.

sentences.zh: 五年，睿親王多爾袞率師圍錦州，命額色赫賚敕諭機宜。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Prince Rui Dorgon led troops to besiege Jinzhou; Esehe was ordered to carry an edict and convey strategic instructions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Prince Rui Dorgon besieged Jinzhou, and Esehe was sent with an edict to convey strategic instructions.

sentences.zh: 會固山額真圖爾格敗明兵於木輪河，使還奏捷。

translations.literal: When Gushan-i Jinggin Turgut defeated Ming troops at Mulin River, he was sent back to report victory.
translations.idiomatic: When Gushan-i Jinggin Turgut defeated Ming forces at Mulin River, Esehe returned as envoy to report the victory.

sentences.zh: 六年，命與圖爾格及大學士範文程、剛林如錦州，按諸將離城遠駐，遣兵還家，睿親王以下坐降罰有差。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he was ordered with Turgut and Grand Academicians Fan Wencheng and Ganglin to go to Jinzhou and investigate generals who had encamped far from the city and sent troops home; from Prince Rui downward, demotions and penalties were imposed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was sent with Turgut and Grand Academicians Fan Wencheng and Ganglin to Jinzhou to investigate generals who had camped too far from the city and sent men home. From Prince Rui downward, demotions and penalties were imposed in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 明總督洪承疇以援師至，上又命額色赫詣軍前授諸將方略，還奏敵勢甚張，當益兵。

translations.literal: When Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou arrived with relief troops, the emperor again ordered Esehe to the front to convey strategy to the generals; returning, he reported that the enemy's strength was very great and more troops should be added.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou arrived with relief forces, the emperor again sent Esehe to the front to instruct the generals. On his return he reported that the enemy was very strong and that reinforcements were needed.

sentences.zh: 上遂自將擊破明軍。

translations.literal: The emperor then personally led the attack and defeated the Ming army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then took command in person and routed the Ming army.

sentences.zh: 既克錦州，又命宣諭慰撫祖大壽及同降諸將士。

translations.literal: After Jinzhou was taken, he was again ordered to proclaim and console Zu Dashou and the other surrendered generals and troops.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinzhou fell, he was again ordered to proclaim the throne's words and reassure Zu Dashou and the other officers and men who had surrendered.

sentences.zh: 八年，從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，略山東，下兗州，同甲喇額真穆成格等奏捷。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he followed Beile Abatai in attacking Ming, raided Shandong, took Yanzhou, and together with Jalan-i Jinggin Mucenge and others reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he followed Beile Abatai against the Ming, raided Shandong, took Yanzhou, and returned with Jalan-i Jinggin Mucenge and others to report victory.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，授世職牛錄章京，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he followed in entering the Pass, was granted the hereditary office of Niru Captain, and given an additional half rank of merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the army through the Pass, was granted the hereditary rank of Niru Captain, and received an additional half step of merit.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷刑部啟心郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was transferred to Qixinlang of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Qixinlang of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢國史院大學士，世職累進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was promoted to Grand Academician of the National History College; his hereditary office was repeatedly advanced to first-rank Adahafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to Grand Academician of the National History College, and his hereditary rank was repeatedly advanced to first-rank Adahafan.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命往朝鮮讞獄。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, he was ordered to go to Korea to judge criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to Korea to adjudicate criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改保和殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was transferred to Grand Academician of the Baohe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made Grand Academician of the Baohe Hall.

sentences.zh: 額色赫再主會試，修太宗實錄，輯太祖、太宗聖訓，纂資政要覽，並充總裁官，累加少師兼太子太師。

translations.literal: Esehe again presided over the metropolitan examination, compiled the Veritable Records of Taizong, edited the Sacred Instructions of Taizu and Taizong, compiled Essentials of Governance for Reference, and served as chief compiler for all; he was repeatedly promoted to Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Esehe again presided over the metropolitan examination, compiled the Veritable Records of Taizong, edited the Sacred Instructions of Taizu and Taizong, and compiled Essentials of Governance for Reference, serving as chief compiler for each. He was repeatedly promoted to Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒，諡文恪。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, he died and was posthumously titled Wenke.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he died and was given the posthumous title Wenke.

sentences.zh: 車克，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲白旗人，世居蘇完。

translations.literal: Che Ke, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner, his family having long resided in Suwan.
translations.idiomatic: Che Ke, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner whose family had long lived in Suwan.

sentences.zh: 祖克爾素，太祖時來歸。

translations.literal: His ancestor Ke'ersu came to submit in the time of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestor Ke'ersu submitted in the time of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 父席爾那，任牛錄額真，卒，車克嗣，兼巴牙喇轄。

translations.literal: His father Xierna served as Niru-i Jinggin; when he died, Che Ke succeeded him and concurrently held command of the Bayara.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xierna had served as Niru-i Jinggin. When he died, Che Ke succeeded him and also held command of the Bayara.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，從上伐明，自大同趨懷遠，薄左衛城，與巴牙喇纛章京圖魯什等設伏，敗明將曹文詔騎兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, he followed the emperor in attacking Ming, from Datong pressed toward Huaiyuan, approached Zuowei city, and with Bayara Banner Captain Tulushi and others set an ambush and defeated the cavalry of Ming general Cao Wenzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tiancong he followed the emperor against the Ming, marched from Datong toward Huaiyuan, and approached Zuowei. With Bayara Banner Captain Tulushi and others he laid an ambush and routed the cavalry of the Ming general Cao Wenzhao.

sentences.zh: 略代州，至五台山，還，遇明將祖大弼兵，擊敗之。

translations.literal: He raided Daizhou, reached Wutai Mountain, and on the return encountered the troops of Ming general Zu Dabu and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He raided Daizhou, reached Mount Wutai, and on the return march met the forces of the Ming general Zu Dabu and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授戶部副理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, he was appointed Deputy Director of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was appointed Deputy Director of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 承政韓大勳私取庫金，事發，車克坐貯庫時未記檔，論死，命罰鍰以贖，仍留部。

translations.literal: Cheng Zheng Han Daxun privately took treasury gold; when the affair came to light, Che Ke was convicted for failing to record it in the ledger when storing the treasury, sentenced to death, ordered to pay a fine to redeem punishment, and retained at the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zheng Han Daxun had privately taken gold from the treasury. When the affair was exposed, Che Ke was held liable for failing to record the deposit in the ledger when he oversaw the vault. Though sentenced to death, he was allowed to pay a fine in commutation and remained at the ministry.

sentences.zh: 尋兼任甲喇額真。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was additionally appointed Jalan-i Jinggin.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon additionally appointed Jalan-i Jinggin.

sentences.zh: 五年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗圍錦州，令車克與噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦勞薩以三百人伏高橋北，坐縱敵，藉家財之半。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in besieging Jinzhou; Che Ke and Gabsi Xianga La'i Angbang Laosa were ordered with three hundred men to lie in ambush north of Gaoqiao Bridge; convicted of letting the enemy escape, half their family property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in the siege of Jinzhou. Che Ke and Gabsi Xianga La'i Angbang Laosa were posted with three hundred men in ambush north of Gaoqiao Bridge. Convicted of letting the enemy escape, they forfeited half their family property.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從攻錦州，擊破明總督洪承疇步兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he again followed in attacking Jinzhou and defeated the infantry of Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again took part in the attack on Jinzhou and routed the infantry of Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou.

sentences.zh: 聖祖即位，召還，調吏部尚書。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Ancestor took the throne, Che Ke was recalled and transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When the Kangxi Emperor ascended the throne, Che Ke was recalled and appointed Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 有阿那庫者，與兄金布爭產，上命均分之。

translations.literal: There was one Anaku who disputed property with his elder brother Jinbu; the emperor ordered it divided equally.
translations.idiomatic: A man named Anaku disputed an inheritance with his elder brother Jinbu, and the emperor ordered the property divided equally between them.

sentences.zh: 既，又與本旗佐領吉詹爭言，吉詹坐阿那庫違上旨。

translations.literal: Afterward he again quarreled in words with his banner's Assistant Commandant Jizhan; Jizhan convicted Anaku of violating the imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: Later Anaku quarreled again with his banner's Assistant Commandant Jizhan, who found Anaku guilty of defying the imperial order.

sentences.zh: 牒戶部，車克移刑部，坐阿那庫罪絞；

translations.literal: The case was sent to the Board of Revenue; Che Ke transferred it to the Board of Punishments and sentenced Anaku to strangulation;
translations.idiomatic: The case was referred to the Board of Revenue, but Che Ke transferred it to the Board of Punishments and sentenced Anaku to strangulation;

sentences.zh: 阿那庫妻擊登聞鼓訟冤，命覆勘，車克當奪官，命削加銜。

translations.literal: Anaku's wife struck the Denunciation Drum to sue for injustice; a re-investigation was ordered; Che Ke should have been stripped of office, but the order was to remove only his additional titles.
translations.idiomatic: Anaku's wife struck the Denunciation Drum to protest the injustice. On re-investigation Che Ke should have been dismissed from office, but the emperor ordered only his additional titles removed.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，复授秘書院大學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, he was again appointed Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi he was again appointed Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.

sentences.zh: 六年，以疾乞休。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, citing illness he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he cited illness and asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 十年，卒，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he died and was posthumously titled Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he died and was given the posthumous title Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 覺羅巴哈納，滿洲鑲白旗人，景祖第三兄索長阿四世孫也。

translations.literal: Jueluo Bahana was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner, a fourth-generation descendant of Suochang'a, the third elder brother of Jingzu.
translations.idiomatic: Jueluo Bahana was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of Suochang'a, the third elder brother of Jingzu.

sentences.zh: 年十七從軍，佐太宗征伐有功。

translations.literal: At seventeen he joined the army and assisted the Taizong on campaigns with merit.
translations.idiomatic: At seventeen he entered military service and aided the Taizong on campaign with distinction.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong, he was granted the hereditary office of Niru Captain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tiancong he was granted the hereditary rank of Niru Captain.

sentences.zh: 九年，命免功臣徭役，分設牛錄，巴哈納與焉。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, an order exempted meritorious ministers from corvée labor and established separate niru; Bahana was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year meritorious ministers were exempted from corvée and given separate niru; Bahana was among them.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，授刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde, he was appointed Director of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he was appointed Director of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢參政，兼正藍旗滿洲梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he was promoted to Canzheng and concurrently served as Meile-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted to Canzheng and concurrently made Meile-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 七年，以刑部勘將佐功罪失平，奪世職。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because the Board of Punishments' assessment of generals' and aides' merits and faults was unfair, his hereditary office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year his hereditary rank was stripped because the Board of Punishments, under his oversight, had judged officers' merits and faults unfairly.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，擢正藍旗滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, he was promoted to Gushan-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he was promoted to Gushan-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 與固山額真石廷柱徇霸州、滄州、德州、臨清，皆下。

translations.literal: Together with Gushan-i Jinggin Shi Tingzhu he reduced Bazhou, Cangzhou, Dezhou, and Linqing—all fell.
translations.idiomatic: With Gushan-i Jinggin Shi Tingzhu he reduced Bazhou, Cangzhou, Dezhou, and Linqing, taking each in turn.

sentences.zh: 移師山西，會固山額真葉臣，招降明總督李化熙等。

translations.literal: He shifted his army to Shanxi, joined Gushan-i Jinggin Ye Chen, and induced the surrender of Ming Governor-General Li Huaxi and others.
translations.idiomatic: He moved his forces into Shanxi, joined Gushan-i Jinggin Ye Chen, and induced Ming Governor-General Li Huaxi and others to surrender.

sentences.zh: 師自汾州趨平陽，與廷柱擊破明兵，至黑龍關，降裨將三、卒六千餘，賚白金，進世職三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: The army from Fenzhou pressed toward Pingyang; with Tingzhu he defeated Ming troops, reached Heilong Pass, induced the surrender of three deputy generals and more than six thousand soldiers, was granted white silver, and his hereditary office was advanced to third-rank Jalan Captain.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched from Fenzhou toward Pingyang; with Tingzhu he routed Ming forces and reached Heilong Pass, where three deputy generals and more than six thousand soldiers surrendered. He was rewarded with silver, and his hereditary rank was advanced to third-rank Jalan Captain.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格下四川，討張獻忠，分兵定遵義、夔州、茂州，斬所置吏數百，降卒數千，盡得其馬騾輜重。

translations.literal: In the third year, he followed Prince Su Haoge into Sichuan to attack Zhang Xianzhong; dividing forces he pacified Zunyi, Kuizhou, and Maozhou, beheaded several hundred appointed officials, induced the surrender of several thousand soldiers, and obtained all their horses, mules, and baggage.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge into Sichuan against Zhang Xianzhong. Detaching columns he secured Zunyi, Kuizhou, and Maozhou, executed several hundred officials Zhang had appointed, accepted the surrender of several thousand troops, and seized all their horses, mules, and baggage.

sentences.zh: 餘寇悉平。

translations.literal: The remaining bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining rebels were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 師還，以勘甲喇章京希爾根軍功失實，又肅親王欲以機賽為巴牙喇纛章京不當，巴哈納與索渾未阻止，且共為奏，議奪官，命降世職拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because the assessment of Jalan Captain Xiergen's military merit was untrue, and because Prince Su wished to appoint Jisai as Bayara Banner Captain improperly—Bahana and Suohun did not stop it and jointly memorialized—the proposal was to strip office; the order was to reduce his hereditary office to Baitalabulehafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was faulted for having approved an inflated report of Jalan Captain Xiergen's merit and for failing, with Suohun, to stop Prince Su's improper appointment of Jisai as Bayara Banner Captain, though they had jointly memorialized on the matter. Though office was to be stripped, the sentence was commuted to reduction of his hereditary rank to Baitalabulehafan.

sentences.zh: 尋擢戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was promoted to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八年，世祖親政，巴哈納奏事畢，上問民間疾苦及國家無益之費，巴哈納舉臨清採磚及通州五閘運漕二事以對，上命即永行停止。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when Shizu personally took power, after Bahana finished reporting affairs the emperor asked about the people's hardships and state expenditures without benefit; Bahana cited brick quarrying at Linqing and grain transport through the five locks at Tongzhou as his answer, and the emperor ordered both permanently stopped at once.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when the Shunzhi Emperor took personal rule, Bahana was asked after reporting on affairs about the people's hardships and wasteful state expenditures. He cited brick quarrying at Linqing and grain transport through the five locks at Tongzhou; the emperor ordered both abolished immediately and permanently.

sentences.zh: 尋兼正白旗滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was additionally appointed Gushan-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon additionally appointed Gushan-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 駐防河間牛錄額真碩爾對訐告戶部發餉不均，下法司鞫問，部議巴哈納阿附睿親王，厚白旗，薄黃旗。

translations.literal: Shuordui, Niru-i Jinggin of the Hejian garrison, impeached the Board of Revenue for unequal distribution of pay; the case was sent to the judicial offices for interrogation; the ministry proposed that Bahana had curried favor with Prince Rui, favoring the White Banner and slighting the Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Shuordui, Niru-i Jinggin of the Hejian garrison, accused the Board of Revenue of unequal pay distribution. After judicial inquiry the ministry held that Bahana had curried favor with Prince Rui, favoring the White Banner while slighting the Yellow.

sentences.zh: 時方治睿親王獄，坐巴哈納罪至死，上命寬之，削世職，奪官，籍其家三之二。

translations.literal: At the time Prince Rui's case was being tried; Bahana was sentenced to death, but the emperor ordered leniency—his hereditary office was stripped, his post removed, and two-thirds of his household property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Rui's case was then under investigation, and Bahana was sentenced to death. The emperor ordered leniency: his hereditary rank was stripped, his office removed, and two-thirds of his household property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 九年，起授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was recalled and appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was recalled and appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十一年，同諸大臣分賑畿輔，賜敕印以行。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, together with other ministers he divided relief duties in the capital region and was granted an edict seal for the mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he joined other ministers in dividing famine relief in the capital region and was granted an edict seal for the mission.

sentences.zh: 累進少傅兼太子太傅。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Junior Tutor and concurrently Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Junior Tutor and concurrently Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十二年，授弘文院大學士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was appointed Grand Academician of the Hongwen College.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was appointed Grand Academician of the Hongwen College.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改中和殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was transferred to Grand Academician of the Zhonghe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made Grand Academician of the Zhonghe Hall.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復設內三院，又改秘書院大學士。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the Three Inner Colleges were re-established, he was again transferred to Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the Three Inner Colleges were restored, he was again made Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，兼鑲白旗滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, he was additionally appointed Gushan-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi he was additionally appointed Gushan-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he died.

sentences.zh: 時鰲拜擅政，巴哈納與不洽，卹不行。

translations.literal: At the time Oboi monopolized power; Bahana was on bad terms with him, and the condolence grant was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Oboi was then dominating the government, and because Bahana was at odds with him, the condolence grant was never issued.

sentences.zh: 聖祖親政，其子巴什以請，贈少師兼太子太師，諡敏壯。

translations.literal: When the Sacred Ancestor personally took power, his son Bashi petitioned on his behalf; Bahana was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Minzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: After the Kangxi Emperor took personal rule, Bahana's son Bashi petitioned on his behalf. He was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Minzhuang.

sentences.zh: 宋權，字元平，河南商丘人。

translations.literal: Song Quan, styled Yuanping, was a native of Shangqiu in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Song Quan, styled Yuanping, came from Shangqiu in Henan.

sentences.zh: 明天啟五年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the fifth year of Tianqi of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the fifth year of the Ming Tianqi reign.

sentences.zh: 官順天巡撫，駐密雲。

translations.literal: He served as Shuntian Governor and was stationed at Miyun.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Governor of Shuntian, stationed at Miyun.

sentences.zh: 受事甫三日，李自成陷京師，權計殺自成將黃錠等。

translations.literal: He had been in office only three days when Li Zicheng took the capital; Quan plotted and killed Li Zicheng's generals Huang Ding and others.
translations.idiomatic: He had been in office only three days when Li Zicheng seized the capital. Quan contrived the killing of Li Zicheng's generals Huang Ding and others.

sentences.zh: 睿親王師入關，籍所部以降，命巡撫如故。

translations.literal: When Prince Rui's army entered the Pass, Quan registered his command and submitted; he was ordered to remain governor as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Rui's army entered the Pass, Quan registered his forces and submitted. He was ordered to continue as governor.

sentences.zh: 權疏言：「舊主禦宇十有七年，宵衣旰食，聲色玩好一無所嗜。

translations.literal: Quan memorialized: 'The former ruler held the realm for seventeen years, rising early and retiring late, with no fondness for music, women, or diversions.
translations.idiomatic: Quan memorialized: 'The former ruler held the throne for seventeen years, laboring from dawn till dusk, with no taste for music, women, or diversions.

sentences.zh: 不幸有君無臣，釀成大亂。

translations.literal: Unfortunately there was a ruler but no ministers, and great disorder was brewed.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, the throne had a ruler but no loyal ministers, and great disorder followed.

sentences.zh: 幸逢聖主，殲亂復仇，祭葬以禮。

translations.literal: Fortunately we have met a sage ruler who destroyed the rebels and avenged the wrong, performing sacrifices and burial according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately a sage ruler has come, destroyed the rebels, avenged the wrong, and performed the rites of sacrifice and burial.

sentences.zh: 倘蒙敕議廟號，以光萬世，則仁至義盡，天下咸頌，四海可傳檄而定。

translations.literal: If an imperial order would deliberate his temple name to glorify him for ten thousand generations, then benevolence and righteousness would be complete, all under Heaven would praise, and the four seas could be settled by proclamation alone.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty would decree deliberation on his temple name to honor him for ages, benevolence and righteousness would be complete, the realm would acclaim it, and the four seas could be pacified by proclamation alone.

sentences.zh: 明朝軍需浩繁，致有加派，有司假公濟私，明徵外有暗徵，公派外有私派，民困已極。

translations.literal: Ming military needs were vast, leading to additional levies; officials used public business for private gain; beyond open collection there was covert collection, beyond public levies there were private levies—the people's distress had reached its limit.
translations.idiomatic: Ming military demands were enormous, leading to supplemental levies. Officials used public office for private gain: beyond open taxes there were hidden ones, beyond official levies private ones. The people's distress had reached its limit.

sentences.zh: 請照萬曆初年為正額，其餘加增悉予蠲免。

translations.literal: I request that the quota of the early Wanli years be taken as the standard amount, and all other additions be entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the tax quota of the early Wanli years be restored as the standard, and all later additions be remitted entirely.

sentences.zh: 勤求上理，宜育賢才。

translations.literal: In diligently seeking good governance, worthy talent ought to be nurtured.
translations.idiomatic: In seeking good governance, worthy talent ought to be cultivated.

sentences.zh: 臣所知者，如王永吉、方大猷、楊毓楫、硃繼祚、葉廷桂等，均濟時舟楫，惟上召而用之。」

translations.literal: Those known to your servant, such as Wang Yongji, Fang Dayou, Yang Yuqi, Zhu Jizuo, Ye Tinggui, and others, are all vessels to ferry the age—may Your Majesty summon and employ them.'
translations.idiomatic: Those I know—Wang Yongji, Fang Dayou, Yang Yuqi, Zhu Jizuo, Ye Tinggui, and others—are all men who could steady the state. I beg Your Majesty to summon and employ them.

sentences.zh: 得旨嘉納。

translations.literal: The memorial received an approving imperial response.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial received an approving imperial response.

sentences.zh: 尋又薦寶坻進士杜立德等十一人。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he again recommended eleven men including Baodi jinshi Du Lide.
translations.idiomatic: He soon recommended eleven more men, including the Baodi jinshi Du Lide.

sentences.zh: 時權仍駐密雲，撫治二十餘州縣，兼領軍事。

translations.literal: At the time Quan was still stationed at Miyun, governing more than twenty prefectures and counties and concurrently commanding military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Quan remained stationed at Miyun, governing more than twenty prefectures and counties while also commanding military affairs.

sentences.zh: 旋以遵化當衝要，命權移駐，先後擊降自成黨數千。

translations.literal: Soon because Zunhua was strategically vital, Quan was ordered to move his station; he successively attacked and induced the surrender of several thousand of Zicheng's followers.
translations.idiomatic: Because Zunhua was strategically vital, he was soon ordered to move his headquarters there and successively attacked and induced the surrender of several thousand of Zicheng's followers.

sentences.zh: 豐潤盜起，權捕治，以未獲其渠，疏請罷斥，溫旨慰留。

translations.literal: Bandits rose at Fengrun; Quan captured and punished them, but because the ringleader was not taken, he memorialized asking to be dismissed; a warm edict comforted him and retained him.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose at Fengrun, Quan suppressed them. Because the ringleader escaped, he asked to be dismissed, but a warm edict comforted him and kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 尋疏陳祖軍、民壯之害，言：「明製祖傳軍籍，隸在營路；

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized on the harm of hereditary military households and civilian braves, saying: 'Under Ming institutions hereditary military registers were subordinate to garrison routes;
translations.idiomatic: He soon memorialized on the harm of hereditary military households and civilian braves: 'Under Ming law hereditary military registers belonged to garrison routes;

sentences.zh: 選取民壯，隸在州縣。

translations.literal: civilian braves were selected and subordinate to prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: civilian braves were selected and assigned to prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 身故則勾子孫，子孫絕則勾宗族，宗族盡則勾戚屬，流離逃竄，亂由此階。

translations.literal: When one died, descendants were pressed; when descendants were exhausted, clansmen were pressed; when clansmen were exhausted, relatives were pressed—wandering flight and disorder arose from this.
translations.idiomatic: When a man died, his descendants were pressed into service; when the line failed, clansmen were pressed; when the clan was exhausted, relatives were pressed. Wandering flight and disorder arose from this.

sentences.zh: 請特沛恩綸，除茲秕政。」

translations.literal: I request a special outpouring of grace to abolish this corrupt policy.'
translations.idiomatic: I beg a special grace to abolish this corrupt practice.'

sentences.zh: 又有私刻順天巡撫印偽為糾舉咨文投部者，事覺，逮治。

translations.literal: There was also one who privately carved the seal of the Shuntian governor and forged impeachment memorials to submit to the ministry; when the affair was discovered, he was arrested and punished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a case of someone who privately carved the Shuntian governor's seal and forged impeachment documents to submit to the ministry. When discovered, the culprit was arrested and punished.

sentences.zh: 權疏言：「用捨者君人之權，黜陟者銓樞之政，薦劾者撫按之職。

translations.literal: Quan memorialized: 'Appointment and dismissal are the sovereign's prerogative; demotion and promotion are the Board of Personnel's affair; recommendation and impeachment are the governor's duty.
translations.idiomatic: Quan memorialized: 'Appointment and dismissal belong to the sovereign; promotion and demotion belong to the Board of Personnel; recommendation and impeachment belong to governors and censors.

sentences.zh: 請飭各省撫按，有關用舍大典，必具疏請，不須以咨文從事，則百弊俱清。」

translations.literal: I request that governors and censors in each province be ordered that whenever the great matter of appointment and dismissal is involved, they must submit a formal memorial and not act by informal communication—then a hundred abuses will all be cleared.'
translations.idiomatic: I ask that governors and censors in every province be instructed: whenever appointment or dismissal is at stake, they must submit a formal memorial and not act by informal communication—then a hundred abuses will be cleared.'

sentences.zh: 疏入，並如所請，著為令。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, all was granted as requested and established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, all was granted as he asked and established as regulation.

sentences.zh: 畿輔既平，詔撥近京荒田及明貴戚內監廢莊，畫為旗地，民田錯雜，別給官田互易。

translations.literal: After the capital region was pacified, an edict allocated wasteland near the capital and abandoned estates of Ming nobles and eunuchs, marked out as banner land; where civilian fields were intermixed, official fields were separately granted in exchange.
translations.idiomatic: After the capital region was pacified, an edict allocated wasteland near Beijing and abandoned estates of Ming nobles and eunuchs as banner land. Where civilian fields were intermixed, official land was granted in exchange.

sentences.zh: 權疏言：「農民甫得易換之田，廬舍無依，耕種未備，請蠲租三年。」

translations.literal: Quan memorialized: 'Farmers have only just obtained exchanged fields; they have no dwellings and their planting is not ready—I request a three-year rent remission.'
translations.idiomatic: Quan memorialized: 'Farmers have only just received exchanged fields. They have no dwellings and their planting is not ready. I ask for a three-year rent remission.'

sentences.zh: 又迭疏請蠲薊州田租一年，除密雲荒地逃丁派徵錢糧，興三協屯政，守兵一予田十畝。

translations.literal: He also repeatedly memorialized requesting a one-year remission of Jizhou land rent, exemption of grain levies on fugitive laborers from Miyun wasteland, and revival of the Three Garrisons' military colonies, granting ten mu of land to each garrison soldier.
translations.idiomatic: He also repeatedly asked for a one-year remission of Jizhou land rent, exemption of levies on fugitive laborers from Miyun wasteland, and revival of the Three Garrisons' military colonies, with ten mu granted to each garrison soldier.

sentences.zh: 俱下部議行。

translations.literal: All were sent to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All were referred to the ministries for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 有詔優恤綠旗陣亡兵家屬，權請特遣部臣蒞視散給，俾霑實惠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered favorable relief for families of Green Banner soldiers killed in battle; Quan requested that a ministry official be specially dispatched to oversee distribution on the spot so they would receive real benefit.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict ordered favorable relief for families of Green Banner soldiers killed in battle, Quan asked that a ministry official be specially dispatched to oversee distribution on the spot so they would receive real benefit.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢國史院大學士。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was promoted to Grand Academician of the National History College.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was promoted to Grand Academician of the National History College.

sentences.zh: 五年，遭母喪，請終制，命如常入直，私居持服。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he suffered his mother's death and requested full mourning; he was ordered to enter duty as usual while observing mourning at home in private.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, after his mother's death, he asked to observe full mourning but was ordered to continue attending court as usual while wearing mourning at home.

sentences.zh: 六年，假歸葬親。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, he took leave to return and bury his parent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he took leave to return home and bury his mother.

sentences.zh: 尋加太子太保。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 七年，還朝。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he returned to court.

sentences.zh: 時議用明例，遺御史巡方，權力持以為不可。

translations.literal: At the time it was proposed to follow Ming precedent and send censors on regional inspection tours; Quan firmly held that this was inadmissible.
translations.idiomatic: At the time some proposed reviving the Ming practice of dispatching censors on regional inspection tours; Quan firmly opposed it.

sentences.zh: 八年，條陳時政，又言宜復設巡按。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he set forth current affairs in items and again said that surveillance censors ought to be re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he set forth current affairs in detail and again argued that surveillance censors ought to be re-established.

sentences.zh: 給事中陳調元、王廷諫等劾權前後持兩端，且追劾其母喪未除，入闈主試，下部議，權老病宜罷歸，遂命致仕。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretaries Chen Diaoyuan, Wang Tingjian, and others impeached Quan for inconsistency before and after, and further impeached him for presiding over examinations while still in mourning; the case was sent to the ministry for deliberation; Quan's age and illness made retirement appropriate, and he was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries Chen Diaoyuan, Wang Tingjian, and others impeached Quan for shifting his position and for presiding over examinations while still in mourning. After ministry deliberation, his age and illness were held to warrant retirement, and he was ordered to leave office.

sentences.zh: 九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he died.

sentences.zh: 部議權被論致仕，祭葬宜殺禮。

translations.literal: The ministry proposed that because Quan had been impeached into retirement, sacrifices and burial should follow reduced rites.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry proposed that because Quan had retired under impeachment, his sacrifices and burial should follow reduced rites.

sentences.zh: 上以權誅自成黨有功，賜祭葬如例，贈少保兼太子太保，諡文康。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Quan had merit in executing Zicheng's followers and granted sacrifices and burial according to precedent, posthumously granting Junior Guardian and concurrently Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Wenkang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that Quan had merit in suppressing Zicheng's followers and granted him full sacrifices and burial, posthumously granting Junior Guardian and concurrently Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Wenkang.

sentences.zh: 子犖，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Luo has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Luo has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 傅以漸，字於磐，山東聊城人。

translations.literal: Fu Yijian, styled Yupán, was a native of Liaocheng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yijian, styled Yupán, came from Liaocheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 順治三年一甲一名進士，授弘文院修撰。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi he placed first in the first rank of jinshi and was appointed Compiler of the Hongwen College.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shunzhi he took first place among the jinshi and was appointed Compiler of the Hongwen College.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷國史院侍講。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to Reader of the National History College.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to Reader of the National History College.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷左庶子。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was transferred to Left Sub-Reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to Left Sub-Reader.

sentences.zh: 十年，歷秘書院侍講學士、少詹事，擢國史院學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he passed through Secretariat Reader, Junior Mentor, and was promoted to Academician of the National History College.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he served as Secretariat Reader, Junior Mentor, and was promoted to National History Academician.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授秘書院大學士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was appointed Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.

sentences.zh: 十二年，詔陳時務，條上安民三事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, an edict called for addressing current affairs; he submitted three items on securing the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when the throne called for reports on current affairs, he submitted three proposals for securing the people.

sentences.zh: 加太子太保，改國史院文學士。

translations.literal: He was additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and transferred to Literary Academician of the National History College.
translations.idiomatic: He was additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and made Literary Academician of the National History College.

sentences.zh: 先後充明史、太宗實錄纂修，太祖、太宗聖訓並通鑑總裁。

translations.literal: He successively served in compiling the History of Ming and the Veritable Records of Taizong, and as chief compiler of the Sacred Instructions of Taizu and Taizong and the Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: He successively helped compile the History of Ming and the Veritable Records of Taizong, and served as chief compiler of the Sacred Instructions of Taizu and Taizong and the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 又命作資政要覽後序，撰內則衍義，覆核賦役全書。

translations.literal: He was also ordered to write the postface to Essentials of Governance for Reference, compile Extended Meaning of the Inner Rules, and review the Complete Book of Tax Levies.
translations.idiomatic: He was also ordered to write the postface to Essentials of Governance for Reference, compile Extended Meaning of the Inner Rules, and review the Complete Book of Tax Levies.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命以漸及庶子曹本榮修易經通注。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, he and Sub-Reader Cao Benrong were ordered to compile a comprehensive commentary on the Book of Changes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he and Sub-Reader Cao Benrong were ordered to compile a comprehensive commentary on the Book of Changes.

sentences.zh: 十五年，偕學士李霨主會試。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, together with Academician Li Hui he presided over the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he and Academician Li Hui presided over the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 考官入闈，例得攜書籍，言官請申禁，以漸請仍如舊例，許之。

translations.literal: Examiners entering the examination compound were by precedent allowed to bring books; censors requested a strict ban; Yijian asked that the old precedent remain, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Examiners entering the compound were by precedent allowed to bring books. When censors asked for a strict ban, Yijian asked that the old rule stand, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 入闈病咯血，請另簡，命力疾料理。

translations.literal: Entering the compound he fell ill with spitting blood and asked for another examiner; he was ordered to manage affairs despite illness.
translations.idiomatic: After entering the compound he fell ill and spat blood, asking to be replaced. He was ordered to carry on despite his illness.

sentences.zh: 尋加少保，改武英殿大學士，兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was additionally appointed Junior Guardian, transferred to Grand Academician of the Wuying Hall, and concurrently served as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon additionally appointed Junior Guardian, made Grand Academician of the Wuying Hall, and concurrently Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 旋乞假還裡，累疏乞休。

translations.literal: Soon he asked leave to return home and repeatedly memorialized requesting retirement.
translations.idiomatic: He soon asked leave to return home and repeatedly memorialized for retirement.

sentences.zh: 十八年，解任。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, he was released from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he left office.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Kangxi he died.

sentences.zh: 呂宮，字長音，江南武進人。

translations.literal: Lü Gong, styled Changyin, was a native of Wujin in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Gong, styled Changyin, came from Wujin in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 順治四年一甲一名進士，授秘書院修撰。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi he placed first in the first rank of jinshi and was appointed Compiler of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shunzhi he took first place among the jinshi and was appointed Compiler of the Secretariat College.

sentences.zh: 九年，加右中允。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was additionally appointed Right Sub-Reader.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was additionally appointed Right Sub-Reader.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，上幸內院，召宮與侍講法若真，編修程芳朝、黃機，命撰柳下惠不以三公易其介論。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year, the emperor visited the Inner College and summoned Gong with Reader Fazhen, Compilers Cheng Fangchao and Huang Ji, ordering them to compose essays on the theme that Liu Xiaohui would not exchange his integrity for the rank of the Three Ducal Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the tenth year the emperor visited the Inner College and summoned Gong with Reader Fazhen and Compilers Cheng Fangchao and Huang Ji, ordering essays on the theme that Liu Xiaohui would not trade his integrity for the rank of the Three Ducal Ministers.

sentences.zh: 宮論有曰：「伊、週、衛、霍，爭介不介。」

translations.literal: Gong's essay said: 'Yi Yin, the Duke of Zhou, Wei Qing, and Huo Qubing—do they contend over integrity or not?'
translations.idiomatic: Gong's essay said, 'Yi Yin, the Duke of Zhou, Wei Qing, and Huo Qubing—do they contend over integrity or not?

sentences.zh: 上喜曰：「此三公語。」

translations.literal: The emperor rejoiced and said: 'These are words fit for the Three Ducal Ministers.'
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and said, 'These are words fit for the Three Ducal Ministers.'

sentences.zh: 列第一。

translations.literal: He was ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: Gong was ranked first.

sentences.zh: 尋諭吏部：「翰林昇轉，舊例論資俸，亦論才品。

translations.literal: Soon the emperor instructed the Board of Personnel: 'Hanlin promotion and transfer, by old precedent, considers seniority and salary, but also talent and character.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor soon instructed the Board of Personnel: 'Hanlin promotions have traditionally weighed seniority, but also talent and character.

sentences.zh: 呂宮文章簡明，氣度閒雅。

translations.literal: Lü Gong's writing is concise and clear, his bearing leisurely and refined.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Gong's writing is concise and clear, his bearing leisurely and refined.

sentences.zh: 遇學士員缺，即行推補。」

translations.literal: When a vacancy for Academician occurs, promote and fill it at once.'
translations.idiomatic: When an Academician's post falls vacant, promote him at once.'

sentences.zh: 尋授秘書院學士。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Academician of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Academician of the Secretariat College.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十二月，超授弘文院大學士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, he was exceptionally appointed Grand Academician of the Hongwen College.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was exceptionally promoted to Grand Academician of the Hongwen College.

sentences.zh: 言官請禁江、浙簽富戶運白糧並織造報充機戶，部議已有例禁，宮復請嚴飭督撫察究。

translations.literal: Censors requested banning the practice in Jiangsu and Zhejiang of assigning wealthy households to transport tribute grain and registering them as loom households for weaving; the ministry had already deliberated a ban by precedent; Gong again requested strict orders to governors and censors to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Censors asked to ban the Jiangsu and Zhejiang practice of assigning wealthy households to transport tribute grain and registering them as loom households. Though the ministry had already ruled on a ban, Gong again asked that governors and censors be strictly ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 大學士陳名夏得罪，十一年，給事中王士禎、御史王秉乾劾宮為名夏黨，宮引罪乞罷，上命省改。

translations.literal: Grand Academician Chen Mingxia fell from favor; in the eleventh year Supervising Secretaries Wang Shizhen and Censor Wang Bingqian impeached Gong as a partisan of Mingxia; Gong confessed guilt and asked to resign; the emperor ordered him to reflect and reform.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Academician Chen Mingxia fell from favor, Supervising Secretaries Wang Shizhen and Censor Wang Bingqian impeached Gong as his partisan in the eleventh year. Gong confessed and asked to resign, but the emperor ordered him to reflect and reform.

sentences.zh: 初，平西王吳三桂專鎮，漸跋扈。

translations.literal: Earlier, Pingxi Prince Wu Sangui held exclusive command of his region and gradually grew overbearing.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Pingxi Prince Wu Sangui had held exclusive command of his region and gradually grew overbearing.

sentences.zh: 宮與名夏及大學士馮銓、成克鞏薦御史郝浴，命巡按四川。

translations.literal: Gong, together with Mingxia and Grand Academicians Feng Quan and Cheng Kegong, recommended Censor Hao Yu and had him ordered to conduct surveillance in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Gong, together with Mingxia and Grand Academicians Feng Quan and Cheng Kegong, had recommended Censor Hao Yu for surveillance duty in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 至是，浴露章劾三桂，三桂疏辨，上為罷浴，宮與銓、克鞏皆坐誤舉，鐫二級留任。

translations.literal: At this time Yu submitted an open memorial impeaching Sangui; Sangui memorialized in defense; the emperor dismissed Yu on Sangui's behalf; Gong, Quan, and Kegong were all convicted of mistaken recommendation, demoted two ranks, and retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: Now Hao Yu submitted an open memorial impeaching Sangui. Sangui memorialized in defense, and the emperor dismissed Yu. Gong, Feng Quan, and Cheng Kegong were all faulted for mistaken recommendation, demoted two ranks, and kept in office.

sentences.zh: 宮以病乞假，上遣醫療治，問病狀。

translations.literal: Gong asked leave for illness; the emperor sent physicians to treat him and inquired about his condition.
translations.idiomatic: Gong asked leave for illness. The emperor sent physicians to treat him and inquired after his condition.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「乞假已三月，禀體怯弱，人道俱絕，僅能僵臥兀坐。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'I have asked leave for three months; my constitution is frail, all human functions are cut off, and I can only lie stiff or sit inert.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: 'I have been on leave for three months. My constitution is frail, all normal functions have failed, and I can only lie stiff or sit inert.

sentences.zh: 乞寬期調治。」

translations.literal: I beg a longer period for recovery.'
translations.idiomatic: I beg a longer period for recovery.'

sentences.zh: 御史姜圖南劾疏語褻嫚，楊義復劾其曠職，宮亦累疏乞罷。

translations.literal: Censor Jiang Tunan impeached the memorial's language as lewd and disrespectful; Yang Yi again impeached him for neglect of duty; Gong also repeatedly memorialized asking to resign.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Jiang Tunan impeached the memorial's language as lewd and disrespectful. Yang Yi again impeached him for neglect of duty, and Gong also repeatedly asked to resign.

sentences.zh: 十二年，以修資政要覽書成，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, because the compilation of Essentials of Governance for Reference was completed, he was additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when Essentials of Governance for Reference was completed, he was additionally appointed Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 宮复疏申請，賜貂裘、蟒緞、鞍馬，命馳驛回籍，俟病痊召用。

translations.literal: Gong again memorialized his request; he was granted a sable coat, python brocade, and saddle horse, and ordered to return home by post relay, to be summoned when recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Gong again petitioned. He was granted a sable coat, python brocade, and a saddle horse, and ordered home by post relay to be summoned when he recovered.

sentences.zh: 十三年，敕存問，賜羊酒。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, an edict inquired after his welfare and granted sheep and wine.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year an edict inquired after his welfare and granted sheep and wine.

sentences.zh: 十七年，詔大學士、尚書自陳，宮不具疏，左都御史魏裔介劾宮「一病六年，聞問杳然，忘君負恩」。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, an edict called on Grand Academicians and ministers to submit self-reports; Gong did not submit a memorial; Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Yijie impeached Gong: 'Ill for six years, no word heard—forgetting the ruler and betraying grace.'
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year an edict called on Grand Academicians and ministers to submit self-reports. Gong did not respond. Left Censor-in-Chief Wei Yijie impeached him: 'Ill for six years without a word—forgetting his sovereign and betraying grace.'

sentences.zh: 上以宮請告無自陳例，諭毋苛求。

translations.literal: The emperor held that there was no precedent for self-report while on leave and instructed that he not be pressed harshly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that there was no precedent for self-report while on leave and instructed that Gong not be pressed harshly.

sentences.zh: 十八年，世祖崩，宮赴都哭臨，病益殆，還裡。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when Shizu died, Gong came to the capital to mourn; his illness grew critical, and he returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the Shunzhi Emperor died, Gong came to the capital to mourn. His illness grew critical, and he returned home.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kangxi he died.

sentences.zh: 成克鞏，字子固，直隸大名人。

translations.literal: Cheng Kegong, styled Zigù, was a native of Daming in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Kegong, styled Zigù, came from Daming in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 父基命，明大學士。

translations.literal: His father Jiming was a Ming Grand Academician.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jiming had been a Ming Grand Academician.

sentences.zh: 克鞏崇禎十六年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: Kegong became a jinshi in the sixteenth year of Chongzhen and was made a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: Kegong received his jinshi in the sixteenth year of Chongzhen and was made a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 避亂里居。

translations.literal: He avoided the turmoil and lived at home.
translations.idiomatic: He retired to his home district to escape the turmoil.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，以左庶子李若琳薦，授國史院檢討。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, on the recommendation of Left Sub-Reader Li Ruolin, he was appointed Reviser of the National History College.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shunzhi, on Left Sub-Reader Li Ruolin's recommendation, he was appointed Reviser of the National History College.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷秘書院侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, he was transferred to Reader of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Reader of the Secretariat College.

sentences.zh: 尋擢弘文院學士。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was promoted to Academician of the Hongwen College.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Academician of the Hongwen College.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢本部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, he was promoted to Minister of his own ministry.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「臣部四司，分省設官，原以諮訪本省官評。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial saying: "The four bureaus of my ministry, with officials set up by province, were originally intended for consulting and inquiring into the evaluations of officials of each province.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial: "The four bureaus of my ministry assign officials by province to consult on the character and performance of each province's officials.

sentences.zh: 請令各司人註一簿，詳列本省各官賢否，參以撫按舉劾，備要缺推選。

translations.literal: I request that each bureau's staff keep a register, listing in detail the merit or demerit of each province's officials, cross-referenced with recommendations and impeachments from governors and surveillance commissioners, to supply selections for important vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that each bureau maintain a register listing each province's officials as worthy or unworthy, drawing on impeachments and recommendations from governors and surveillance commissioners, to guide promotion to key posts.

sentences.zh: 督撫舊無考成，請令疏列事蹟，消弭盜賊，開墾荒田，清理錢糧，糾除貪悍，定為四則，以別賞罰。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors formerly had no performance assessment; I request that they be ordered to set forth their deeds in memorials—suppressing bandits, opening and cultivating wasteland, clearing up taxes and grain dues, rooting out greed and ruthlessness—establishing these as four standards to distinguish rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-general and governors have never faced formal performance review. I ask that they be required to report their achievements in four areas: suppressing bandits, reclaiming wasteland, clearing tax arrears, and rooting out corrupt and brutal officials—using these as standards for reward and punishment.

sentences.zh: 文選推升，概從掣籤。

translations.literal: Promotions through the Bureau of Appointments are entirely by lottery.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments at the Bureau of Appointments are made entirely by drawing lots.

sentences.zh: 但地方繁、簡、衝、僻不同，如江南蘇、松等郡積弊之區，非初任邑令所能振刷。

translations.literal: But localities differ in being busy, simple, strategic, or remote; districts like Suzhou and Songjiang in Jiangnan, where abuses have accumulated, cannot be revived by a newly appointed county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: But districts vary—some are busy, some quiet, some strategic, some remote. Places like Suzhou and Songjiang in Jiangnan, where abuses have piled up for years, cannot be set right by a first-time county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 請取卓異官，或升或調，通融補授。

translations.literal: I request that outstanding officials be selected, promoted or transferred as needed, and flexibly appointed to fill gaps.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that proven officials of exceptional merit be promoted or transferred and appointed with discretion to fill such posts.

sentences.zh: 行之有效，即加優擢，亦於選法無礙。」

translations.literal: If this proves effective, they may at once receive special promotion, without conflict with appointment rules."
translations.idiomatic: If they succeed, they should receive preferential promotion without violating appointment law.

sentences.zh: 章下所司。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to the appropriate offices.

sentences.zh: 尋擢秘書院大學士。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was promoted to Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Grand Academician of the Secretariat College.

sentences.zh: 以薦御史郝浴失人，鐫二級。

translations.literal: For recommending Censor Hao Yu in error, he was demoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Because his recommendation of Censor Hao Yu had been mistaken, he was demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 十二年，命還所降級。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was ordered to have his demoted ranks restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the emperor ordered his demoted ranks restored.

sentences.zh: 十二年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 左都御史缺員，命克鞏暫攝，並諭俟得其人，仍回內院。

translations.literal: With the Left Censor-in-Chief's post vacant, Kegong was ordered to serve ad interim, and was also instructed that once a proper appointee was found, he should return to the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: When the Left Censor-in-Chief's post fell vacant, Cheng Kegong was ordered to fill it temporarily and told to return to the inner court once a permanent appointee was found.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「用人為治平之急務，而大僚​​尤重。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial saying: "The appointment of men is an urgent task for governing and pacifying the realm, and high officials are especially important.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial: "Selecting men for office is the most urgent business of good government, and senior officials matter above all.

sentences.zh: 今通政使李日芳、甘肅巡撫周文葉、陝西巡撫陳極新皆衰老昏庸，亟當更易。

translations.literal: Now the Transmission Commissioner Li Rifang, Gansu Governor Zhou Wenye, and Shaanxi Governor Chen Jixin are all aged, feeble, and incompetent; they should be replaced at once.
translations.idiomatic: Transmission Commissioner Li Rifang, Gansu Governor Zhou Wenye, and Shaanxi Governor Chen Jixin are all old, feeble, and incompetent and should be replaced immediately.

sentences.zh: 財用困乏，宜定丈量編審之期。

translations.literal: The treasury is straitened; fixed dates should be set for land measurement and registration review.
translations.idiomatic: State finances are strained; deadlines should be set for land surveys and tax registration.

sentences.zh: 學校冒濫，宜嚴考貢入學之額。

translations.literal: Schools are overrun with unqualified entrants; the quotas for examination and tribute-pupil admissions should be strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Schools are overcrowded with unqualified students; entrance quotas for examination graduates and tribute pupils should be strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 任樞密者，遇封疆失事，不得借行查以滋推諉。

translations.literal: Those charged with military affairs, when border provinces suffer failure, must not use field investigation as a pretext for shirking responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in charge of military affairs must not use field inspections as an excuse to evade blame when frontier provinces suffer setbacks.

sentences.zh: 司刑憲者，於棍徒詐害，不得寬反坐以長刁風。

translations.literal: Those who administer the law, in cases where ruffians commit fraud and harm, must not leniently apply counter-charges that encourage a culture of sharp practice.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial officers must not leniently apply counter-charges against accusers in cases of ruffian fraud, lest it embolden legal trickery.

sentences.zh: 又若修築河工，宜覈冒銷，杜侵帑。

translations.literal: Again, in river conservancy works, false expenditures should be verified and treasury embezzlement stopped.
translations.idiomatic: River works should be audited for padded expenses and embezzlement from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 此數事皆當振刷，以圖實政。」

translations.literal: These several matters all ought to be vigorously addressed to pursue real governance."
translations.idiomatic: All these matters demand vigorous reform if government is to produce real results.

sentences.zh: 上深韙之。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor strongly approved.

sentences.zh: 給事中孫光祀劾左通政吳達兄逵叛逆，下法司勘擬。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Sun Guangsi impeached Left Transmission Vice Commissioner Wu Da's elder brother Kui for rebellion; the case was sent to the judicial offices for investigation and sentencing proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Sun Guangsi impeached Wu Da's elder brother Kui for rebellion. The case was referred to the judicial offices for investigation.

sentences.zh: 克鞏疏論左都御史龔鼎孳與達同鄉，徇隱不舉，鼎孳疏辨不知逵為達弟，坐奪俸。

translations.literal: Kegong submitted a memorial arguing that Left Censor-in-Chief Gong Dingzi, being from the same native place as Da, had shielded him and failed to impeach; Dingzi submitted a defense saying he did not know Kui was Da's younger brother, and was sentenced to forfeiture of salary.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Kegong charged that Left Censor-in-Chief Gong Dingzi, a fellow townsman of Wu Da, had concealed the matter and failed to impeach. Dingzi replied that he had not known Kui was Wu Da's brother and was sentenced to forfeiture of salary.

sentences.zh: 尋命克鞏回內院。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Kegong was ordered to return to the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Kegong was soon ordered back to the inner court.

sentences.zh: 十五年，加少保，改保和殿大學士，兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, he was made Junior Guardian, transferred to Grand Academician of the Baohe Hall, and concurrently Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was made Junior Guardian, Grand Academician of the Baohe Hall, and concurrently Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十六年，加少傅兼太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was made Junior Mentor and concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made Junior Mentor and Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遵例自陳，諭不必求罷。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, following precedent he offered his resignation; he was instructed that he need not seek dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he submitted the customary self-criticism; the emperor told him he need not seek retirement.

sentences.zh: 部推浙江布政參議李昌祚擢大理寺少卿。

translations.literal: The ministry recommended promoting Zhejiang Provincial Administration Commissioner Assistant Li Changzuo to Vice Director of the Court of Review.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry proposed promoting Li Changzuo, Assistant Commissioner of the Zhejiang provincial administration, to Vice Director of the Court of Review.

sentences.zh: 先是，揚州亂民李之春事發，其黨亦有名李昌祚者，克鞏與大學士劉正宗票擬未陳明；

translations.literal: Previously, when the affair of the Yangzhou rebel Li Zhichun came to light, among his followers was also one named Li Changzuo; Kegong and Grand Academician Liu Zhengzong drafted the rescript without making this clear;
